description: Figure 6(a) is a bar chart illustrating the distribution of datasets over time for the five most frequent researcher locations and all other locations combined. The horizontal axis represents the years from 2012 to 2022, while the vertical axis shows the number of datasets, with a logarithmic scale ranging from 10^0 to 10^2. The chart includes bars for each year, with the height of each bar representing the number of datasets for that year. The bars are color-coded to represent different locations, with the US researchers consistently having the highest number of datasets, followed by other countries. The chart shows a general increase in the number of datasets over time, with a notable rise in datasets from other countries since 2017.
